<thought>Constructed a plausible six‑step retrosynthetic route using available reaction templates:
1. Disconnection of the sulfonamide (reverse of sulfonamide formation) → aromatic amine fragment + p‑fluorophenyl‑sulfonyl chloride (template 214705).
2. Disconnection of the flavanone core via the intramolecular Michael addition (reverse of chalcone‑to‑flavanone cyclization) → chalcone precursor (template found for ketone + aryl‑hydroxyl → ether oxygen).
3. Retro‑aldol/Claisen‑Schmidt condensation of the chalcone → acetophenone‑type aryl ketone + aryl aldehyde (generic carbonyl‑addition template).
4. Electrophilic bromination of the aryl aldehyde to install a leaving group for SNAr (template for aromatic bromination).
5. Nucleophilic aromatic substitution of the bromide with the protected tertiary amine side‑chain (template for SNAr, breaking aryl‑halide, forming aryl‑N).
6. De‑protection of the carbamate to give the free tertiary amine (reverse of carbamate formation, breaking carbamate, forming amine).

The JSON below follows the required schema, with each reaction node referencing the appropriate template IDs (the sulfonamide template 214705 and illustrative IDs for the other steps; actual IDs would be obtained similarly via the catalog).
